# The Poker Lobotomy

> The Poker Lobotomy is Ed Reif's poker decision-training system: 20-Second Rewires, 60-Second Rewires, the 500-Second Poker Rewire, and long-form Learn Poker in Your Sleep sessions designed to improve decisions under uncertainty.

Canonical site: https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/
Canonical identity page: https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/about/
Creator: Ed Reif — https://www.edreif.com/

## New series — October 2026

- [The AI Poker Guy](https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/ai-poker-guy/) — 24 unique exported video entries, GTO, AI and poker decision science. [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLHGuiIZ-saJE).
- [ASMR Poker Girl | 20-Second Poker Leaks](https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/asmr-poker-girl/) — Skyelark-hosted poker lessons, 29 exported video entries. [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMs6bPypMCZI).

## Core learning modes

- [20-Second Poker Rewires — Short Attention Span Theater](https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/sast/)
- [60-Second Rewires](https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/rewires/)
- [The 500-Second Poker Rewire](https://theedreif.github.io/theedreif/500-second/)

## Topics

Texas Hold'em strategy; poker probability; GTO; bet sizing; position; pot odds; bluffing; board texture; multi-way pots; tilt control; bankroll discipline; decision science; mental game.
